title: Container child rollup and state aggregation queries
description:
Progress over a container (epic or story) is computed client-side today: agents loop a per-child show command or run counter scripts over query output. Transcript mining found ~30 such loops and rollups, and an external tool reimplemented the same aggregation from raw storage files.

## Background

Showing a container lists its dependencies but offers no aggregate; repository status is global only. The needed views are per-child status and counts by state for a container or label bucket. Decided: the dependency DAG is authoritative for containment; membership labels are advisory grouping.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] [hard] REQ-01: A command lists a container's children with short id, state, title, and gate rollup per child, in text and JSON.
- [ ] [hard] REQ-02: An aggregation form reports counts by state and done/total for a container or any label filter.
- [ ] [hard] REQ-03: Rollup membership follows the dependency DAG (containment edges authoritative, labels advisory), and the documentation states this.
- [ ] [hard] REQ-04: Documented in the CLI reference with the JSON shapes.
